station_name: Mono Creek at Mono dam site, near Santa Barbara, Calif.
notes: Yearly discharge table, water years 1903 and 1904 (dated as water years; printed maximum dates are Apr. 1, 1903 and Feb. 27, 1904). Counted like a monthly summary table: maximum, minimum day and mean cells are measurements: 1903 = 710, 0, 12.3 (water-year mean), 12.1 (calendar-year mean) = 4; 1904 = 285 only (rest dashes) = 1; total 5. Runoff in acre-feet (8,970 and 8,790) are conversions: only in n_variables = 7. W.S.P. no. 300 is an identifier, not counted. Unsure only because the rules do not say how a yearly summary table is counted. "192." before the station name is the report's own number, not a USGS station number. Other distances: 0.5 mile upstream from mouth, 3.2 miles east of Gibraltar Dam, 7.5 miles northeast of Santa Barbara.
